lines.zh: 光从缝里漏下来，刺眼睛。
lines.en: Light leaks through the cracks and stings.

lines.zh: 八只脚各走各的，不会乱。
lines.en: Eight feet, each its own step, none straying.

lines.zh: 这条路我织过一千张网。
lines.en: I have spun a thousand webs on this road.

lines.zh: 上面挂着我的网，脚步轻点。
lines.en: My web hangs above - keep your steps light.
I'll rest after this stretch of web.
In the dark, I climb the walls after you.

lines.zh: 丝线牵着我，走不回岔路。
lines.en: The silk leads me; I never take a wrong turn.
Beyond the web lies my nest.
My web is stickier than a spider's.

lines.zh: 触角先伸进黑缝里探路。
lines.en: My feelers reach into the dark crack first.
I spin my web across the cave roof.

lines.zh: 土在松，下面有东西在爬。
lines.en: The soil loosens - something crawls beneath.
The wind of undergrowth pushes me.

lines.zh: 蜕皮要躺一天，走路省事。
lines.en: Molting costs me a day; walking is easier.
The shadow under my web is mine.
A sweet smell drifts from the far end.
My feelers droop. Sleepy.

lines.zh: 谁在洞壁上敲，一下一下。
lines.en: Someone taps the cave wall, again and again.
The web is spun, and it waits for you.

lines.zh: 一天没动静，网还是新的。
lines.en: A quiet day; my web is still fresh.
The web is still, and so am I.
Grains of sand caught in my web.
I hang on a thread like a dead leaf.

lines.zh: 前足蹭了蹭，声音就出来了。
lines.en: My forelegs brush, and the sound comes.
The bright spot at the cave mouth creeps in.
I climb walls by silk, not hands.
Web's spun. I forgot what for.

lines.zh: 风停了，我的网也不晃了。
lines.en: The wind dies and my web stops swaying.
I've woven your face into my web.

lines.zh: 你一弯腰，影子就压到网。
lines.en: Bend over and your shadow hits my web.

lines.zh: 站在网边上，是来送食的？
lines.en: Standing by my web - here to feed me?

lines.zh: 我在暗处结网，等你走进去。
lines.en: I web the dark and wait for you to enter.
Eight eyes, and not one blinks.
I hung the threads on that wall.
The web is mine; so are you.

lines.zh: 你脚底下那根丝是我的。
lines.en: The thread under your foot is mine.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，不像虫子。
lines.en: You don't smell like a bug.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太响，沙都跳了。
lines.en: Your steps are so loud the sand jumps.
My shell splits and silk seeps from the crack.
My own web tangles my legs.
Don't hit my legs - I still need to climb.

lines.zh: 蛛丝断了，触角也断了一截。
lines.en: My silk snapped, and a feeler broke.
The silk broke; I can spin more.
All legs intact - I can still climb walls.

lines.zh: 壳上添了道印，腿还全在。
lines.en: A mark on my shell - all my legs still work.
A rank smell rises from my cracked shell.

lines.zh: 背后一凉，谁碰了我的网？
lines.en: A chill behind me - who touched my web?
I've stepped back half a pace; fangs still bared.

lines.zh: 让我用触角碰碰你的手。
lines.en: Let my feelers touch your hand.

lines.zh: 蛛网先铺好，再请你进来。
lines.en: The web is laid before I invite you in.
Smells like a bug fresh out of its shell.
My belly is quiet, but my fangs itch.
The web was laid long ago.
This web isn't a trap, is it?

lines.zh: 我最爱吃的是甜的东西。
lines.en: Sweet things are my favorite.

lines.zh: 你手里那点，够我裹一层丝。
lines.en: That much would wrap one layer of silk.

lines.zh: 我先绕两圈，再决定咬哪。
lines.en: I'll circle twice, then choose where to bite.
That piece could line my nest floor.

lines.zh: 洞这么窄，你我先挤一挤。
lines.en: The cave's this narrow - we'll squeeze by.
I back off if you do; the web still holds.
Feet snap the silk; eyes never do.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的味道留我身上。
lines.en: One bump and your scent stays on me.

lines.zh: 八条腿打滑，差点翻个身。
lines.en: Eight legs slipped - I nearly rolled over.
You're standing on my leg - let go.

lines.zh: 我八条腿，全抓在你甲上。
lines.en: All eight of my legs grip your armour.
Next time walk around my web.
My web is the threshold; don't step.
Only at half health do I fight close.
You take the silk sac; I'll carry the egg sac.

lines.zh: 我摩擦前足，给你听个声。
lines.en: I rub my forelegs to make you a sound.
Hanging from the roof, I weave all night.
I'll pull a thread; you turn with me.

lines.zh: 我背上的斑纹，你看清了吗？
lines.en: Did you see the markings on my back?
The web is big enough - stay a while.
I wove a new nest on the cave roof.
The silk's still wet - what's the rush?
Few can walk walls like I do.
A brood of spiderlings will fill these walls.

lines.zh: 八条腿背这点东西，不算重。
lines.en: Eight legs carry this easily.

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，得拖回洞。
lines.en: Something this big must be dragged home.
One wrap of my web and you stop.
A fleck of gold, bright enough all night.

lines.zh: 亮晶晶的，能换一张好网。
lines.en: Something shiny - worth a good web.

lines.zh: 谁掉的丝囊？没人？那我的。
lines.en: Who dropped this silk sac? Nobody? Mine then.
Webbing under your feet. Don't struggle.

lines.zh: 丝缠了三圈，抬也抬得动。
lines.en: Three wraps of silk and I can lift it.
I never fall while climbing walls.
A little sweet; I've tucked it in my silk sac.

lines.zh: 我的网，从洞顶铺到地面。
lines.en: My web runs from ceiling to floor.
The fangs land before the scream does.

lines.zh: 这个大小，正好裹进网里。
lines.en: This size wraps neatly in webbing.
The web mouth closed behind you.
You're blocking my web mouth - saves me the chase.
A little bug — just right for my teeth.
My silk wraps your feet first.
The silk sings - those are my steps.
The web opening fits your shoulders exactly.
One jab of venom and your legs fold.
The silk is strung. Take your time.
I'll count two beats, then you should run.
Those prints in the sand - I follow them.

lines.zh: 我的丝能穿过蛛网，你不会。
lines.en: I pass through webs; you do not.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起动，你追不上。
lines.en: Eight legs at once - you cannot catch me.

lines.zh: 你汗里的咸味，顺着丝来。
lines.en: The salt in your sweat rides the silk to me.

lines.zh: 别跑，丝已经挂住你的鞋。
lines.en: Don't run - a thread has caught your shoe.
I cut across the web - faster than you.

lines.zh: 八条腿换着跑，我不用歇。
lines.en: Eight legs take turns; I never rest.

lines.zh: 你躲的那块石头，我爬得上。
lines.en: That rock you hide behind? I can climb it.

lines.zh: 阿拉克涅的丝，先封住门。
lines.en: Arachne's silk seals the door first.
I'm hanging from the roof, looking down.
Eight legs on the wall, you cannot keep up.
I climb the wall and watch from above.
Keep the fang marks - watch your step.
My fangs come down on your wrist.

lines.zh: 个子小，牙可一点都不小。
lines.en: Small frame, but the fangs are anything but.

lines.zh: 你的手比我的网慢半拍。
lines.en: Your hand is half a beat behind my web.
Below half health, I close in.
Climbing walls is faster than walking.

lines.zh: 你躲开一根丝，还有八根。
lines.en: You dodged one thread; there are eight more.
My fangs caught you - bear with it.
The fangs are in. Stay still.
Poison seeps through the seams - you can't block it.
In the dark, I spin the first strand.
Silk already hangs in the cave mouth.
I open my eyes and the web is already spun.

lines.zh: 八条腿站稳，网也挂好了。
lines.en: Eight legs braced, web already hung.

lines.zh: 外面的光刺得我睁不开。
lines.en: The outside light blinds me.
One move of my legs and the web trembles.
Who spun this silk on the cave roof?

lines.zh: 我从网底下翻身站起来。
lines.en: I roll over and rise from under the web.

lines.zh: 丝动了一下，我跟着醒了。
lines.en: The silk stirred, and I woke with it.
Too dark in here - I touch the wall.
Fire scorched my leg and charred my shell.
I fell out of my own web.
Water covers my abdomen; my silk goes soft.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀到洞壁上了。
lines.en: The blast threw me against the cave wall.

lines.zh: 一支尖东西卡在甲缝里。
lines.en: Something sharp is stuck in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 咒语让我的八只眼发花。
lines.en: The spell blurs all eight of my eyes.
My silk sac is empty and my belly's flat.
My shell still tingles; stay back.

lines.zh: 网断了，我掉进没有底的洞。
lines.en: My web snapped and I fell into a bottomless hole.
